Name: Crystal Island - Ginger Island's Override
Author: BackedPotatoes
Description:
I made this mod for players like me who want the Ginger Island to have a more fantasy and magical look. I want the island to feel alive and enchanting, a place where I actually look forward to visit! [b]🐱 [/b]
﻿I have big plans for this mod!

[center][img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbXFpMm5ubTRzb3oxMTF3anhkanZsOWI3aDEwbHRvOG1qc2VhNzdqZyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/LtXHQDCa6ymokU3x8x/giphy.gif[/img][/center]

[left]
﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/l20T8HY.png[/img]
[size=2][b]
﻿1.[/b] Download this mod
﻿ ﻿[b]2.[/b] Drop the folder inside your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder
﻿﻿﻿Yeay! Now you can play with the mod ^^[/size]

[url=http:]
﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/I9kOlI4.png[/img]
[/url][/left]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Visual override: [/b]changes the trees, the ground, bushes, music, and much more![/size][/*]
[*][b]Seasonal Island! [/b]A optional feature that makes the Island changes with the seasons (winter won't snow).[/*]
[*][size=2][b]Witches! [/b]Instead of pirates, a new witch cove with a new look and new music.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Ravens [/b](and [b]bats[/b], if enabled) replacing the parrots![/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Crystals and mushrooms throughout the whole island.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]New [b]crops [/b]and [b]furniture[/b].[/size][/*]
[*]New witch [b]shops [/b]in the cove![/*]
[*][size=2]Find new statues, messages, and secrets![/size][/*]
[/list]  [size=2]My goal is to make the Island a mystical forest which is actually nice to go play in it!

﻿If you use the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35358]They Deserve It Too[/url], the witches will have portraits![/size]

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/X0ONZOw.png[/img]


[size=3]  ﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/hlehbfb.png[/img][/size]

[list]
[*][size=2][b]Change Parrots:[/b] Choose if you want to replace the parrots with [b]ravens[/b], or both [b]ravens and bats[/b]. Default is ravens only.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Pirates to Witches: [/b]Witches will replace the pirates, alongside the pirate cove decor and the music.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Crops and Fruits:[/b] Changes the banana, pineapple, ginger, etc, and their respective recipes to new crops.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Seasonal Island: [/b]Makes Island seasonal or static.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Weeds's texture:[/b] Purple recolor, Crystals, or false. Default Purple weeds.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Grass replaces dirt:[/b] Changes the dirt ground for a green recolor. Default false.[/size][/*]
[*][b]Island Farm's House:[/b] Changes the outside texture and animations of the Island's Farmhouse.[/*]
[*][b]Portraits' Style:[/b] Vanilla and Nyapu-style.[/*]
[*][b]Witch Shop:[/b] Adds a new witch merchant, and a brooms shop for the brooms witch.[/*]
[*][b]Purple Sand: [/b]Recolors the sand of the Island with a slight purple tone.[/*]
[*][b]Replace Palm Trees:[/b] Have pine trees instead of palm trees.[/*]
[*][b]Palette Theme:[/b] Vanilla, Bog's or Simple Foliage option.[/*]
[*][b]Palette Recolor: [/b]Vanilla or Earthy option.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*][size=2][b]Texture Patch:[/b] Mainly for android users or players with the mod Clear Glasses. If there's black squares around the textures, enable this.[/size][/*]
[*][b]Animations:[/b] Option to turn off some animations in case you have a lower end pc and see performance issues.[/*]
[*][b]Reload Trees:[/b] If it's not a new save/you don't want to manually chop down the trees for the pines to appear, enables this. Restart you game. Disable after fix.[/*]
[/list][size=2]  ﻿Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Config Mod[/url]﻿ to change these options.[/size]

Check the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4288]FAQ[/url] here!


[size=3]  ﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/KdwLUol.png[/img][/size]

[list]
[*]﻿There might be issues with mods that edit the map of the Island, but if there's any incompatibility,[b] let me know[/b] and I'll add a patch for it. [/*]
[*]"Can I install it mid-save?" Yes.[/*]
[/list]
[b][color=#b6d7a8]  ﻿this mod works with:[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Recolors[/*]
[*]SVE[/*]
[*]Ginger Island Extra Locations - Redux[/*]
[*]Buildable Ginger Island[/*]
[*]Lnh's Ginger Island Overhaul[/*]
[/list]Please note that Lnh's asks for a new save, with or without Crystal Island!


﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/3ANQ15K.png[/img]

[list]
[*][size=2]Way more [b]details and animations.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=2]A [b]new NPC[/b] for the Island.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Fully replace the "tropical" look for a more fantasy retexture.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Bogs' matching palette option!  [b]🐱 [/b][/size][/*]
[/list]

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/vvmTMha.png[/img]

My friend [b]Sasha[/b]—my first beta player who dealt with my stress while I was trying to bug fix this lmao <3

﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/142995153]Jupm[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu]Nyapu[/url] and [url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdvcharactercreator]JazzyBee [/url]for letting me use their assets to create the witches' portraits!
